theorem: The lower coherent adjacent-integer competitor is the auxiliary origin on every open sector. This follows from 0<A,B<1 and the shared LOWER branch; it is not guessed from orbit closure.
native_typing: DOWN_raw auxiliary [0,0,0] is stored natively only as the glued origin state (±1,±1,±1); auxiliary 0 is never called a native coordinate.
